title: The spinor type number formula for totally definite quaternion orders
summary: Let $D$ be a totally definite quaternion algebra over a totally real number field $F$, and $\mathcal{O}$ be an $O_F$-order (of full rank) in $D$. The type number $t(\mathcal{O})$ is an important arithmetic invariant of $\mathcal{O}$ that counts the number of isomorphism classes of orders belonging to the same genus as $\mathcal{O}$ (i.e. locally isomorphic to $\mathcal{O}$ at every finite place $\mathfrak{p}$ of $F$).
